prompt: A typographic poster design in portrait orientation. The entire background is a flat solid black surface with tiny scattered white specks. All lettering is pure white with a worn distressed print texture. The poster contains exactly five words arranged as four stacked lines that form one tall column centered on the canvas; the block occupies the middle three quarters of the width and leaves wide empty black margins on all four sides. Line one, at the top, reads "HARD DAYS" in medium decorative vintage serif capitals. Line two reads "FORGE" in very large decorative vintage serif capitals with an oversized first letter and slightly playful letter heights. Line three reads "STEADY" in the same medium decorative vintage serif capitals as line one. Line four, at the bottom, reads "HEARTS" in the same decorative vintage serif capitals as line two. Main lines are much larger than the small connecting words. Thin ornamental rules made of dotted lines and small curled scrolls separate the lines, and symmetrical Victorian flourish ornaments sit above the top line and below the bottom line. The only text in the image is these five words, each appearing once. The image uses only pure white and pure black, one white ink on a clean black background.
